scope: Authenticated web JSON and decorative media scheduling; no stock runtime, native app backend, model, or pairing change
changes: Negotiated asynchronous gzip for JSON; audio and other binary payloads remain byte exact
API requests high priority; atlas requests low priority, two downloads maximum, no motion downloads before catalog paint
Display clock sleeps while all requested pages are unavailable; original animation resumes as assets arrive
Static assets revalidate with ETags instead of mandatory complete reload; API responses remain no-store
Cold catalog reports loading/failure explicitly; bootstrap failures are observed
checks: Actual throttled Chromium large inventory/selected message with positive animation
Shared session state and stale response/filter protection
Read feedback, scoped errors, draft retention and real WebSocket activity burst
Modeled pixel animation, offscreen/decoded caches, reduced-motion and freeze/resume
limits: Controlled synthetic network benchmark is not a universal phone or production latency claim
Fresh production browser reopen still required before marking deployed
Prior coalescing-only release rolled back after empty catalog observation; slow raw transfer reproduced on the previous release too
